title: Man Vs Baby | Official Trailer | Netflix

segments.description: Close-up shot of Rowan Atkinson as Trevor Bingley staring directly into the camera in confusion while talking to a police officer on a video tablet.
Medium tracking shot of Rowan Atkinson talking on his phone while walking inside a home interior.
Medium action shot of Trevor reacting in panic as a baby basket flies across a hallway and lands in an entryway.
Medium tracking shot of Trevor driving a red car while feeding a baby with a bottle in the passenger seat.
Medium close-up of Trevor arguing with a police officer on the phone over mispronounced names, establishing comedic frustration.
Close-up shot of Trevor peeking under a red hooded jacket to check on a baby before silencing a receptionist.
Medium wide shot of Trevor wearing a Housesitters Deluxe jacket and talking awkwardly with a luxury mansion owner.
Medium shot of Trevor preparing champagne and celebrating by the window while a baby sleeps peacefully in a basket nearby.
Medium tracking shot of Trevor pushing a baby in a shopping trolley along a festive winter street adorned with Christmas lights.
Medium close-up montage of comedic mishaps including Trevor wearing an apron, opening water faucets, and multitasking with babies on a sofa.
Wide shot of Trevor chatting with mothers in a park with his baby in a shopping cart, concluding with the Netflix release date title card.
